limitations: Candidate review covers the named nearby implementations, not exhaustive catalog semantic equivalence.

FFT projection, numeric peak/phase operations, MCC threshold selection and generic-width fold fitting are domain-independent. Consecutive triples, nine-feature order, fixed tree hyperparameters and five-way coverage are explicit recipe restrictions.

Synthetic cases execute all125 models with the10000-round ceiling and100-round stopping patience; early stopping determines actual iterations. No historical accuracy, historical floating-point replay or generalization claim.
Both heldouts affect early stopping; threshold fitting uses in-training scores. The optimizer uses >= while final decisions use strict > and repeat across three signals.
Numeric shape checks and callability do not authenticate same-invocation provenance or callable semantics; exact registered graph bindings are required.
Actual-length waveform clipping and one-cycle FFT interpretation are declared independent generalizations. Source notebook code is not copied or licensed by this review.
Installed files match their own RECORD hashes; independent publisher authentication, clean deployment and other platforms are not certified.

Two synthetic cases execute all125 models with full source stopping limits, exact numeric callables and final signal decisions; reference equality does not certify historical accuracy or cross-domain generalization.

qualification.parameter_contract: Validate and copy a complete version1 invocation without extracting features or fitting models. Inputs: payload: Finite JSON dictionary with exactly version=1, training and query. Training has signals, labels, identities; query has signals, identities. Bounds: At most64MiB canonical JSON. Finite real sample-by-signal matrices with equal sample counts>=3 and nonempty consecutive triples. Training integer binary labels align as measurements-by3. Nonempty unique opaque identity strings align per measurement and are disjoint between populations. Validate all125 random folds before returning. Extract the first positive-frequency real FFT coefficient per column. Inputs: values: Finite real rank2 sample-by-signal matrix with at least3 samples and one column. Bounds: Cast to float64 and compute rfft along axis0, index1; reject nonfinite coefficients. Frequency means one cycle per supplied length, without physical time units or a three-column restriction. Construct first-order baseline subtraction filter arguments. Inputs: values: Nonempty finite real vector.; retention: Finite numeric scalar in[0,1], excluding bool. Bounds: Return b=[a,-a], denominator=[1,-a], independent float64 input, axis=-1 and initial delay[-a*x0]. No filtering occurs here. Copy a filtered vector and set its first value to zero. Inputs: filtered: Nonempty finite real filtered vector. Bounds: Copy to float64, then overwrite index0. Does not authenticate filter coefficients, input provenance or the initial state. Intersect forward and reverse directional plateau-midpoint maxima. Inputs: values: Nonempty finite real vector.; window: Positive Python integer excluding bool. Bounds: Preserve asymmetric directional advancement and plateau midpoints; intersect reflected reverse indexes. Empty output is valid. This is not a symmetric sliding maximum filter. Rank supplied candidates by descending absolute residual amplitude. Inputs: residual: Nonempty finite real vector.; positions: At least2 unique in-range integer positions. Bounds: Use reversed NumPy argsort of absolute amplitudes; ties follow that implementation, not a stable chronological tie rule. Convolve adjacent amplitude differences with a uniform kernel and trim both ends. Inputs: heights: At least2 finite nonnegative descending real amplitudes.; width: Positive Python integer.; trim: Nonnegative Python integer. Bounds: Full convolution with ones(width)/width, then [trim:-trim]; trim0 retains everything. Empty trimmed output is valid; reject nonfinite arithmetic. Use a cumulative threshold-hit knee and restore chronological order. Inputs: positions: At least2 unique nonnegative integer positions.; heights: Aligned finite nonnegative descending amplitudes.; gradient: Finite real rank1 vector, possibly empty.; threshold: Finite numeric scalar excluding bool.; count: Positive Python integer.; offset: Nonnegative Python integer. Bounds: Count nonconsecutive gradient>threshold hits. Knee is position of count-th hit minus count minus offset, or -offset when too few hits. Apply Python [:knee] unchanged, including negative slicing. No upper position bound or gradient provenance is independently established. Compute normalized neighbor, opposite-extremum and sawtooth descriptors. Inputs: positions: Rank1 in-range integer peak positions; empty accepted.; residual: Nonempty finite real vector with nonzero amplitude at every selected peak.; small_radius: Positive Python integer.; large_radius: Positive Python integer. Bounds: Actual-length clipped windows. Columns are absolute next/peak, previous/peak, signed opposite-extremum offset subtracting small_radius even at boundaries, and normalized sawtooth MSE. Missing neighbors retain NaN. Require normalized waveform maximum aligned with template maximum; reject infinity. Assign right-closed phase quadrants relative to a supplied Fourier coefficient. Inputs: positions: Rank1 in-range integer positions; empty accepted.; coefficient: Finite numeric scalar Fourier coefficient for the same signal.; length: Python integer>=3 matching the full signal length. Bounds: Compute (degrees(2*pi*positions/length+angle(coefficient))+90)%360. Right-closed bins yield0..3; exactly zero yields-1. Matching coefficient provenance is caller responsibility. Collect peak records through nine explicitly supplied numeric callables. Inputs: values: Finite real sample-by-signal matrix with samples>=3 and complete consecutive triples.; coefficients: Aligned finite coefficient vector from the same signal matrix.; controls: Exactly retention,window,width,trim,threshold,count,offset,small_radius,large_radius.; arguments_function: Qualified callable(values,retention) returning five filter arguments.; filter_function: Qualified callable(b,a,x,axis,zi) returning filtered samples.; residual_function: Qualified callable(filtered) returning residuals.; maxima_function: Qualified callable(values,window) returning candidates.; rank_function: Qualified callable(residual,positions) returning ranked positions and heights.; gradient_function: Qualified callable(heights,width,trim) returning gradient.; selection_function: Qualified callable(positions,heights,gradient,threshold,count,offset) returning selected positions,heights,knee.; descriptor_function: Qualified callable(positions,residual,small_radius,large_radius) returning four descriptors.; phase_function: Qualified callable(positions,coefficient,length) returning quadrants. Bounds: Visit every column serially; group index=column//3. Check descriptor and phase alignment. Shape checks and callability do not authenticate semantics or matching provenance. Control value validation is delegated to qualified operations. Aggregate nine numeric features per explicitly supplied group. Inputs: groups: Rank1 integer group indexes in[0,measurement_count).; heights: Aligned finite strictly positive real heights.; descriptors: Peak-by4 real matrix; NaN allowed only in first2 columns.; quadrants: Aligned integer values in{-1,0,1,2,3}.; measurement_count: Positive Python integer. Bounds: Exclude next-neighbor ratio>.33333 with height>50. Count quadrants0/2, all, and1/3. For0/2 compute height mean/sample std and means of previous ratio,next ratio,absolute opposite offset,sawtooth MSE. Missing groups and undefined summaries retain NaN; reject infinity. Reorder nine features and derive measurement labels from triples. Inputs: training: Nonempty real training-by9 matrix; NaN allowed, infinity rejected.; signal_labels: Aligned training-by3 integer binary labels.; query: Nonempty real query-by9 matrix; NaN allowed, infinity rejected. Bounds: Copy feature columns in order[2,7,3,4,8,0,6,5,1]; label a measurement positive when any signal is positive. Copy signal labels. Project the five declared training controls in fixed order. Inputs: controls: Dictionary from the validated invocation with repetitions,split_seed,tree_seed,rounds,patience. Bounds: No independent value validation; extra keys are ignored and missing keys reject. Downstream fold and fit operations validate numeric bounds. Construct class-specific random five-way partitions with rotating heldouts. Inputs: labels: Nonempty integer binary vector containing both classes.; seed: Nonnegative Python integer.; repetitions: Positive Python integer with seed+repetitions-1<2**32. Bounds: RandomState(seed+iteration), assign class1 then class0 independently to integers0..4. Each of5 rotations uses one validation fold, next test fold and remaining3 training folds. Reject empty heldouts or training without both classes. Fit a generic-width binary LightGBM model with two early-stopping populations. Inputs: training: Nonempty real rank2 features; NaN allowed, infinity rejected.; labels: Aligned integer binary vector.; query: Nonempty real rank2 features of matching width; NaN allowed.; train: Nonempty integer training indexes with both classes.; validation: Nonempty integer validation indexes.; test: Nonempty integer nominal-test indexes.; tree_seed: Python integer in[0,2**31).; rounds: Positive Python integer iteration ceiling.; patience: Positive Python integer early-stopping patience. Bounds: Three index vectors must be disjoint and cover every training row exactly once. Binary GBDT, rate.01,80leaves, feature/bagging fractions.8, bagging frequency1, deterministic column-wise CPU with one thread. Both heldouts influence binary-logloss early stopping; neither is untouched test evidence. Execute every supplied fold and accumulate count-normalized scores. Inputs: training: Nonempty real rank2 features; NaN allowed.; labels: Aligned integer binary vector.; query: Nonempty real rank2 features of matching width; NaN allowed.; plans: List of5*repetitions complete disjoint three-way partitions.; repetitions: Positive Python integer.; tree_seed: Python integer in[0,2**31).; rounds: Positive Python integer.; patience: Positive Python integer.; fold_function: Qualified callable with fit_fold signature and output order. Bounds: Validate all partitions before fitting; each row must occur3*repetitions in training and repetitions in each heldout. Validate finite[0,1] returned vectors and iteration1..rounds. Execute serially in plan order, averaging query scores per fold and row scores by coverage. Callable authenticity is a graph concern. Expose the training-probability member of an ensemble result. Inputs: trained: Matching qualified ensemble dictionary containing training_probabilities. Bounds: Returns the existing object without copy or independent validation. Caller must not mutate it or substitute mismatched provenance. Align triple signal labels with repeated measurement probabilities. Inputs: signal_labels: Nonempty measurement-by3 integer binary labels.; training_probabilities: Aligned finite real measurement probabilities in[0,1]. Bounds: Flatten labels in row order and repeat each measurement score3times. No claim that in-training probabilities are unbiased validation. Maximize grouped MCC over observed probability thresholds. Inputs: labels: Nonempty integer binary vector.; probabilities: Aligned finite real vector in[0,1]. Bounds: Group tied probabilities, evaluate decision probability>=threshold at observed values only. Zero denominator gives MCC0; select largest threshold among equal best scores. Does not add an all-negative candidate above the maximum. Apply strict query threshold and repeat the decision across each triple. Inputs: ensemble_result: Matching ensemble dictionary with nonempty finite query probabilities in[0,1].; selected: Exactly threshold and mcc; finite threshold in[0,1] and finite mcc. Bounds: Decision uses strict > although optimizer uses >=. Return a shallow dictionary extension; existing arrays remain shared. Does not independently validate other ensemble fields or prove selected threshold provenance. Encode the qualified final output as finite JSON-compatible values. Inputs: trained: Matching result dictionary with probability and signal-decision arrays,threshold,models,scope. Bounds: Convert arrays to lists and retain exactly five fields. Require finite JSON; do not independently validate shapes, probability ranges, integer labels or provenance.
